en: Oh... This floorboard got no nails in it.

Yeah. Floorboard just resting on top of
<CLT=cltSTRONG>crosspiece<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
I suppose it's not just my imagination.

But each floorboard is thick and they got
no gaps between them, so it look okay...

Gonta not worry about falling through
floor all of a sudden.

But, it's pretty dark here...
It's a little hard to see where we're stepping.

And in the corner, there's a hole in the floor,
so it might not be good to go over there.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's really dim, so it's difficult
to move around...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can see a gap in the corner.
I should be careful...
